editorial:
Imagine feeling like you are losing your mind because the one person you are supposed to trust is actually a monster. You will feel for the main character, a teenage girl who realizes her new stepfather is not the nice guy everyone thinks he is. He is secretly trying to kill her and her mother, but he is so good at playing the part of a loving husband that nobody believes her. It creates a really tense vibe where you just want to scream at the screen for people to listen to her before it is too late.

The acting is solid and keeps you on edge, though some parts move a bit slow until the scary stuff really kicks in. You will love the suspense, but you might find the lack of trust from the adults frustrating. If you enjoy old-school thrillers with a lot of tension, you should definitely check this out. It looks great in high definition, making those sneaky moments feel even more real.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a final showdown where the stepfather's true nature is finally revealed to everyone. After trying to cover his tracks and gaslight the family, he makes a mistake that proves the girl was right all along. There is a violent struggle, but the daughter and mother manage to fight back and survive his attacks. The police arrive just in time to stop him, and he is finally caught for his crimes.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and stories about surviving a villain.
